saw_lines: Beauty shoppers often reorder a brand they know, but a new buyer first checks the price and whether it arrives.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where a new buyer weighs price and delivery.
Your site shows 168 and 180 reviews, yet 0 of 30 ads carry a proof number. Put one review count on the creative and open two ads with a review quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: Your site shows 168 and 180 reviews, yet 0 of 30 ads carry a proof number, so new buyers get no reason to trust it. Put one review count on the creative and open two ads with a review quote.
Your site offers 10% off orders from CHF 99, yet 0 of 27 ads mention percent off, so first buyers get no reason to act. Put that offer in line one of three new ads and on the creative.

Your site states free shipping from CHF 150, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery, so new buyers hesitate before clicking. Open new ads with the shipping answer and the CHF 150 threshold on the creative.
Your 27 copy ads open 18 different ways, the biggest only 3 times, so no story gets tested enough to show what works. Pick the two best stories and build the next batch from them, three ads each.
